title: SPEC-MAT-001 — Procurement & Supplier Quality Events
description: Document 113 event contract for the events app/modules/supplier_quality/commands.py actually emits. Only 1 of the catalogue's 7 declared Document 18 events is implemented: SupplierQualificationApproved. SupplierMaterialApproved, SupplierSuspended, SupplierDisqualified, PurchaseRequisitionApproved, PurchaseOrderIssued and PurchaseOrderRegulatedFieldsChanged are declared in 07_EVENT_CATALOGUE.yaml but have no producing code path anywhere in the codebase -- procurement (requisition/PO creation) is not built as a native flow here (Document 48/49 route PO ownership through the ERP integration, and app/modules/erp/ has no PO-specific event either), and supplier suspension/disqualification transitions beyond initial qualification approval are not yet built. Verified directly against source (grep across app/, not assumption).
